name: genui-platform
description: GenUI Platform: GUP wire schemas, conformance fixtures, and the reference kernel.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p kernel/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p adapters/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p interaction/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p face/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/http-sse/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/mcp-http/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/apps/host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/backend-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/agent-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/control-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p providers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run conformance && npm run typecheck && npm run test:jsonata && npm run test:vitest
